_comment: Chapter 6 of the story revamp (docs/gameplay/23 §4): F28, a mass rescue: the gifted children from the ledger, asleep in crystal cradles (home.children: the village school; mercy + 1).

text.zh_TW: 搖籃大廳裡排滿了水晶搖籃。每一個搖籃裡都睡著一個孩子——名冊上的那些孩子。凱的聲音很輕：「……他們還在呼吸。」
text.en: The Hall of Cradles is lined with crystal cradles. In each one sleeps a child: the children from the ledger. Kai's voice is very quiet. "...They're still breathing."

label.zh_TW: （輕輕地敲碎水晶，一個一個叫醒他們）
label.en: (Break the crystals gently and wake them one by one)

text.zh_TW: 孩子們揉著眼睛坐起來。最小的那個抓住你的袖子：「哥哥，你是來帶我們回家的嗎？」
text.en: The children sit up, rubbing their eyes. The smallest one grabs your sleeve. "Big brother, have you come to take us home?"

label.en: "Yes. Mira's waiting for you in the village."
